scripts.serve: node -e "const http = require('http'); const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const server = http.createServer((req, res) => { let filePath = path.join(__dirname, 'dist', req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url); if (!fs.existsSync(filePath) || fs.statSync(filePath).isDirectory()) filePath = path.join(__dirname, 'dist', 'index.html'); res.setHeader('Content-Type', filePath.endsWith('.js') ? 'application/javascript' : filePath.endsWith('.css') ? 'text/css' : 'text/html'); res.end(fs.readFileSync(filePath)); }); server.listen(process.env.PORT || 3000, '0.0.0.0', () => console.log('Server running on port', process.env.PORT || 3000));"
